summary: Architected core frontend modules and reusable component systems for an enterprise UK healthcare platform.
highlights: Architected core frontend modules for the YourMedicals Prescriber Portal, delivering responsive UI components and interactive clinical workflows.
Engineered an Order Management Dashboard with multi-column filtering, pagination, and real-time search utilizing TanStack Table.
Integrated secure REST APIs via Axios and optimized client-side state caching using TanStack Query to streamline network data fetching.
Collaborated in cross-functional Agile sprints with backend engineers, designers, and QA teams to ship production-ready features on schedule.
